subject: Orchid Therapeutics — Embedded MAP & Canary Readiness
messages:
From: Jennifer Kim <jennifer.kim@orchidtx.com>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 22:03:00 +0000
Subject: Implementation sequencing & MAP items for onboarding

Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is aligned to move forward. Before legal/ops kicks off procurement, our implementation lead asked for a single MAP that embeds the rollout, canary, migration windows, and training schedule so we can align internal stakeholders and the vendors who will assist with migration.

High level asks:
- A proposed canary week where we run a narrowed traffic slice to the Redwood Dedicated endpoint (we prefer a Tue–Thu window in PST).
- Migration cutover approach — can we support blue/green for our primary integration?
- Training slots for the SRE and product teams (2 x 90m sessions + a recording).
- Quick SOC 2 evidence summary we can share with procurement for the first pass.

I attached Orchid_MAP_template.xlsx with our internal milestones — feel free to edit and return. Let me know if you prefer a quick 30m sync to finalize windows.

Best,
Jennifer Kim
Director, Technical Programs
Orchid Therapeutics

Attachments: Orchid_MAP_template.xlsx

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Jennifer Kim <jennifer.kim@orchidtx.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Implementation sequencing & MAP items for onboarding

Jennifer — thanks for the clear asks. Drafting a consolidated MAP that includes the canary window, migration approach, training plan and a SOC2 summary.

Quick proposal (draft attached):
- Canary window: Tue 2025-06-03 — Thu 2025-06-05, PST (narrow feature flag + 10% traffic slice).
- Migration: blue/green with incremental cutover and rollback gates at each step; full fallback plan in runbook.
- Training: two 90m sessions (2025-05-27 & 2025-05-29) plus a recorded walkthrough for the SRE team.
- SOC2: attached a 1-page summary you can forward to procurement.

I've attached Orchid_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), Runbook_draft.md (runbook skeleton), and SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf (one-pager). Laura and Markus — can you review the rollback gates and the estimated validation steps (smoke tests, prefix cache warm, KV validation)?

If that looks good to you, Jennifer, I'll publish a shared Drive folder and send a HubSpot update to lock timelines.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Orchid_MAP_v1.xlsx; Runbook_draft.md; SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 11:30:00 +0000
Subject: Internal — quick alignment on Orchid MAP (do not forward)

Laura/Markus —

Summarized action items from my note to Jennifer: please reply inline to confirm ownership.

1) Rollback gates (Markus) — confirm the list below and whether we need an automated canary monitor or manual sign-off:
   - Response-time spike > 2.5x baseline for > 5m -> automatic rollback
   - Error-rate > 1% for > 10m -> investigate; fallback if unresolved
   - Semantic regression on sample prompts (we will run the canary-set prompts) -> manual rollback

2) Runbook status (Laura) — flesh out the cutover checklist for the integration team, include KV cache warm steps, and a checklist for prefix caching.

3) Trainings (Laura) — record the second session and upload to Drive; ensure the SRE checklist is included as a one-pager.

4) Procurement/SOC2 (Evelyn) — I pushed the SOC2 one-pager into the draft Drive folder; will route to procurement once Jennifer confirms.

Please mark tasks in INF-742 and add estimated hours so we can feed to the PM.

Thanks —
Evelyn

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Jennifer Kim <jennifer.kim@orchidtx.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@orchidtx.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 08:00:00 +0000
Subject: Final MAP + Canary & Training schedule (Orchid Therapeutics)

Jennifer/Ravi — attaching the finalized MAP and runbook draft. Summary below and callouts for procurement:

Summary (final):
- Canary window: Tue 2025-06-03 02:00 UTC — Thu 2025-06-05 22:00 UTC (Redwood Dedicated, 10% traffic, feature flag).
- Cutover style: blue/green with incremental routing; full rollback path documented (Runbook_draft.md).
- Training: 90m live session for SRE & product (2025-05-27 16:00 UTC); 90m deep-dive for integrators (2025-05-29 16:00 UTC). Recording and SRE checklist to follow.
- Procurement: SOC2 summary attached for first pass; procurement team asked for an authority contact for evidence requests — please loop procurement@orchidtx.com and I will connect them to our compliance lead.

Drive and tracker: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEFgHiJkLMnOpQ
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/ORCH-2314
Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-742

Next steps:
- Jennifer: confirm canary window OK by EOD 2025-05-15 or we'll shift to 2025-06-10 slot.
- Markus/Laura: complete Runbook edits and add gates to INF-742 by 2025-05-16.
- I will send calendar invites for the two training sessions once the times above are confirmed.

Attachments: Orchid_MAP_v1.xlsx; Runbook_draft.md; SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Jennifer Kim <jennifer.kim@orchidtx.com>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orchidtx.com, ravi.patel@orchidtx.com
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 13:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Final MAP + Canary & Training schedule (Orchid Therapeutics)

Evelyn — this looks good. Confirming the 2025-06-03 canary window works for our operations team. Procurement is on copied and will start evidence requests tomorrow.

Two quick notes:
- For the canary prompts we will provide a 25-item validation set (will share by 2025-05-20).
- Please include an explicit cost estimate line in the MAP for canary traffic (approx. compute hours + transient storage) — procurement asked for it to include in the internal P&L.

I'll wait for the calendar invites for training.

Best,
Jennifer Kim
Director, Technical Programs
Orchid Therapeutics
